military.note: Civil War: Private, 2nd Battery, Connecticut Volunteer Light Artillery; enlisted 23 Feb 1864, discharged 9 Aug 1865. VA master index card gives death 15 Nov 1890, pension claim XC 2665391 and widow's certificate WC 329170; card address 39 Lawrence St., Wilkes-Barre.

bioAdditions:
The husband of Ellen Jane Pringle (daughter of Andrew G. Pringle and Catherine Scott) was a Civil War veteran. His Veterans Administration master index card reads 'Randall, Francis J., Pvt 2 Batty Conn Vol Lt Art', enlisted 23 Feb 1864, discharged 9 Aug 1865, died 15 Nov 1890, with a widow's pension certificate (WC 329170) and claim number XC 2665391, and an address at 39 Lawrence St., Wilkes-Barre (S1). The FamilySearch tree gives his birth as about 1846 in Pennsylvania and a first marriage, about 1868, to Sarah E. VanDuzen (1849-1876), by whom he had a daughter Katherine May (b. Plymouth 24 Apr 1869). He then married Ellen Jane Pringle at Plymouth on 14 Dec 1876, when she was 14, and they had Frederick (1878-1931) and Gertrude Helen (1882-1956). He was in Lackawanna Twp. in 1870 and Plymouth in 1880 (as 'Frank Randel'), and died at Plymouth on 15 Nov 1890 (S2). Bradsby (1893) names Ellen's husband as 'Francis Randell' (S3).

The 1938 Pennsylvania death index lists Ellen J. Randall of Wilkes-Barre, died 12 Mar 1938, file 30118. That fits the FS tree date for his widow (S4).
